G'oya

Xato yoshni qatordan olib tashlamaymiz, faqat uni NULL ga aylantiramiz. CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 6 AND 18 THEN age END haqiqiy yoshni o'zicha qoldiradi, qolganida ELSE yo'q va natija NULL. AVG NULL larni hisobga olmaydi, COUNT(*) esa qatorlarni sanaydi.

Yechim

SELECT grade,
       COUNT(*) AS students,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 6 AND 18 THEN age END), 1) AS avg_age
FROM students
GROUP BY grade

BETWEEN ikkala chegarani ham o'z ichiga oladi: 6 va 18 haqiqiy.

Tuzoqlar

Eng ko'p uchraydigani filtrni WHERE ga qo'yish:

Noto'g'riSELECT grade, COUNT(*) AS students, ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS avg_age
FROM students
WHERE age BETWEEN 6 AND 18
GROUP BY grade

O'rtacha to'g'ri chiqadi, lekin yoshi xato o'quvchilar sondan ham tushib qoladi. Sinfdagi hamma yosh xato bo'lsa, sinfning o'zi natijadan yo'qoladi.

COUNT(age) ham shunga o'xshash xato: u yoshi NULL o'quvchilarni sanamaydi.
